_comment: Scripted Kanglish consultations. The mock STT returns the segments and the mock LLM returns the note. They double as the scripts to act out when recording the demo audio; have a native Kannada speaker polish the lines first.

segments: Doctor, mooru dina inda thumba thale novu, swalpa jwara kooda ide.
Gantalu novu ideya? Any allergy to medicines?
Gantalu novu ide. Allergy gottilla doctor.
Sari. I am prescribing Amoxicillin 500 mg three times a day for five days, and Paracetamol 650 if there is fever. Bisi neeru kudiri, rest madi.

note.summary: Ravi reports a severe headache with mild fever and sore throat for 3 days and is not aware of any drug allergy. Amoxicillin and paracetamol were prescribed.

segments: Namaskara Lakshmi avare, hegiddira? Enu thondare?
Doctor, eradu vaara inda mandi novu, mettilu hattuvaaga jaasti aagutte.
Bere yaavudadru maatre thagothira? Any other medicines?
BP maatre thagothini, adu bittu bere enu illa.
Sari. Brufen 400 bareetini, dinakke eradu sala oota aadmele, five days. Knee exercises maadi.

relevant_history: Takes blood pressure tablets; reports no other medicines
note.summary: Lakshmi reports knee pain for two weeks, worse when climbing stairs, and says she takes only blood pressure tablets. Brufen 400 mg twice a day after food was prescribed for 5 days.

segments: Namaskara Arjun avare, hegiddira? Sugar hege ide?
Doctor, ee naduve thumba sustu aagtide, baayarike kooda jaasti.
Maatre sariyaagi thagothira? Taking Metformin regularly?
Haudu doctor, dinakke eradu sala thagothini. Health camp alli cholesterol jaasti ide andru, Atorvastatin 10 kottidru, raatri thagothini.
Sari, continue Metformin 500 twice daily, Atorvastatin 10 raatri continue maadi. Oota control maadi, dina walking maadi. One month nalli follow-up baniri.

relevant_history: Known diabetes; reports taking metformin twice daily
High cholesterol found at a health camp; started atorvastatin 10 mg at night there
note.summary: Arjun reports recent tiredness and increased thirst and says he takes metformin regularly. He was told at a health camp that his cholesterol is high and takes atorvastatin 10 mg at night. Metformin and atorvastatin were continued, with diet and walking advice and a follow-up in one month.
